_comment: Evidence-backed prose claims that are NOT reducible to a single capability status (those live in capabilities.json). Each claim carries its evidence, the date it was last verified, and — when a date is set — the verifier and the verified_artifact backing it. FRESHNESS is enforced automatically by scripts/verify-claims.mjs in CI: a null date, a date with no verifier/verified_artifact, or a date older than the budget (default WARN 60d / FAIL 90d, per-claim max_age_days override) fails the build. That check proves freshness, NOT truth — truth (whether the claim actually holds) remains a human review item at release, backed by each claim's evidence. See docs/adr/0002-capabilities-manifest.md.

claims.claim: Governance — the same identity, policy and audit — has been demonstrated across ADK, LangChain and OpenAI adapters: one governance layer, not one per framework.
evidence: forge-agents/harness/phase1e_adk_conformance.py (live: governance survives the framework swap to ADK)

claims.verified_note: Verified by a dated PASSING run of the phase1e LIVE conformance harnesses against the europe substrate + europe operator KMS key (single Cloud Run job execution, fail-closed): ADK 7/7 PASS, OpenAI 9/9 PASS across BOTH delegation surfaces (handoff + agent_tool). This is a stronger footing than when the homepage first made the claim. LangChain here rests on published+conformance-tested vaid-langchain, not this live run.
